content.title: What Time Is the Oscars: The 2026 Oscars (98th Academy Awards) take place tonight, Sunday, March 15, 2026, starting at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT. The ceremony, hosted by Conan O'Brien from the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles, will air live on ABC and stream on Hulu. Red carpet coverage begins earlier, starting around 3:30 p.m. | Meeko Media | Facebook
